subject: PV yield estimation

finding.claim: NREL's PVWatts Calculator is the named estimator for PV yield. The generated source used 0.80 as a PVWatts-derived default performance assumption, an assumption about a generic system. A yield projection states its observation interval, system size, performance assumption, source dataset, location and irradiance origin (satellite reanalysis or ground station).

method: Reading of the cited sources on 2026-09-05, carried into this record on 2026-10-30 from the September 19 note.
